checks: The actual 3D pan moves to its trivet. An active empty burner does not heat it, and ingredient drops follow the new pan location.
Pouring only flows over the relocated pan; stirring and turning pieces also use its current position. Release stops pouring and conserves saved water.
Invalid drops and Escape preserve position. Keyboard alternatives move the same pan; its surface cools gradually off the burner.
Graphics-context loss cancels an uncommitted lift and leaves usable text controls.
Pan transfers survive reload, appear in exported evidence and replay, and remain locked for completed work.
Real touch transfer and cancellation work without WebGL. Narrow layouts and automated accessibility checks pass.
